sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of FruitySwipes revolve around connecting chains of the same colored fruits on a grid. The game starts with a random selection of fruits, and your goal is to create the longest possible chain by tapping on one fruit icon and moving your finger around the screen to select more of the same. The fruits can be connected horizontally or vertically, and the game will reward you with points and bonuses for creating longer chains.

As you progress through the levels, the game will introduce new fruits, each with its unique points and bonuses. Some fruits will give you bonus points for creating a specific chain, while others will grant you power-ups to help you clear the board. The game's mechanics are simple yet addictive, making it easy to learn but challenging to master.

One of the key features of FruitySwipes is its ability to keep track of your progress and provide you with rewards for achieving specific milestones. As you clear levels, you'll earn rewards in the form of coins, gems, and other in-game currency. These rewards can be used to unlock new fruits, power-ups, and other in-game items, giving you a sense of accomplishment and motivation to continue playing.

The game's core mechanics are easy to learn, but the difficulty level increases as you progress through the levels. The game will introduce new challenges, such as blocked fruits, obstacles, and limited moves, to keep you on your toes. However, with practice and patience, you'll develop the skills and strategies needed to overcome these challenges and succeed in the game.
